stages.name: Poolish (12 h ahead)
stages.note: Mix 12 h ahead and ferment in an airtight container at 21–24 °C (12–16 h).

ingredients.note: 5 % of the water, to dissolve the salt

method: Make the poolish 12 h ahead.

By hand: stir the salt into ① (the salt water) and set aside. Dissolve the yeast in ②, add ③ with the poolish and mix to a shaggy mass; autolyse 30 min. Add ① and mix until homogeneous. Bulk 3½ h with 3 four-edge folds (one every hour after the first hour), then 30 min rest.

Shape and proof (book table). Divide: baguette or short baguette 350 g, ficelle 250 g, roll 50 g, small boule/bâtard 500 g, large boule/bâtard — don't divide. Proofed when a gentle finger press feels bubbly inside and springs back very slowly; if it springs back fast, give it more time (check every 30 min). Or cold-proof at 4 °C: 50–250 g pieces 2 h, 350–500 g 2½–3 h, 1–2 kg 3½–4 h.

Turn the dough gently out onto a well-floured bench — keep the gas in.

Move the loaves seam side down onto a peel or loader, score, and load straight into the preheated oven.
